chunks: From the servant of Allah, Ali, Commander of the Faithful, to Abdullah ibn Qays.
ai.seo_question: Who was the recipient of Imam Ali's letter when he discouraged Abu Musa Ashaari from jihad?
ai.summary: This salutation serves as the formal opening to Imam Ali’s (AS) letter to Abdullah ibn Qays (Abu Musa al-Ashari), the governor of Kufa, specifically addressing his perceived discouragement of jihad. It establishes the Caliph’s authoritative voice and sets the stage for a critique of administrative complacency, reflecting the political and spiritual tensions of the early Islamic period as recorded in Sharif al-Radi’s *Nahj al-Balagha*.
